title: Yellowed Flaky Italian Poppy Seeds Torta Caprese
description: A satvik-friendly, fermented, flaky Italian dish featuring poppy seeds and pickle, wrapped in a ti-leaf wrap, inspired by the traditional Torta Caprese.
instructions: Soak the poppy seeds in water overnight and drain well.
In a large bowl, combine the soaked poppy seeds, chopped pickle, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Mix well and let it ferment for 2 hours.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the fermented poppy seed mixture to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a surface and place a quarter of the poppy seed mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the ti leaf over the filling to form a square shape and repeat with the remaining mixture and leaves.
Serve the Yellowed Flaky Italian Poppy Seeds Torta Caprese hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
